mechanism: Chlorthalidone can cause electrolyte abnormalities and volume depletion that may potentiate atomoxetine's sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular risk; atomoxetine may increase blood pressure which could be exacerbated by thiazide diuretics.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if hypokalemia develops or cardiovascular effects become problematic.
